notes.title: 22 December patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be teleported on initial spawn in match
[*] Fixed bug with decals rendering on certain player meshes
[*] Flipped the rails around on the SVD and Ak47
[*] Fixed bug with being able to float after vaulting
[*] Improved vaulting to better support going through tight windows
[*] Added max texture resolution graphics option
[*] Removed weapons and scopes that shouldn't be in game
[*] Fixed crash when loading to the main menu from a missing widget in the package
[*] Fixed crash when loading a map due to invalid save data in the inventory class
[*] Fixed bug with vault not being replicated properly on clients
[*] Re-enabled auto refresh when first opening the main menu for the server browser
[*] Replaced the old android icon with updated image
[*] Replaced pf din text pro light fonts with pf din text pro regular
[*] Moved the M4 to a sidearm instead of primary weapon
[*] Fixed bug with incorrect fire mode icons on the HUD
[*] Fixed bug with the G18 not playing reload animations when in automatic fire mode
[*] Adjusted ADS offsets for all weapons
[*] Renamed some loadout menu headers and updated the default values to be more proper
[*] Fixed multiple weapon animation rotation issues
[/list]

notes.title: 22th November Patch
notes.content:
New build is online and we are testing new patch with following updates:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with being able to unequip a weapon multiple time with the mouse wheel
[*] Fixed bug with loadout changes not waiting until next spawn
[*] Fixed bug with players not joining teams properly when too many players were in game
[*] Fixed end of match issues with floating text boxes, players running in place and floating arms
[*] Fixed bug where the player would leave a corpse at the start of a match
[*] Fixed issue where sleeves could be missing on spawn
[*] Fixed incorrect physics models being used for dropped weapons
[*] Added negative score prevention to the new team scoring system
[*] Fixed bug with gun attack animations not being loaded in packaged games
[*] Fixed bug with the status screen not showing when joining a lobby
[*] Fixed bug with the player count for lobbies being force to 16 instead of 12
[*] Fixed bug with grenades spawning in the wrong locations
[*] Removed weapon info from the HUD while using grenades and knives
[*] Fixed bug with sleeves not loading on clients
[*] Fixed bug where the main menu loadout screen wouldn't populate in packaged games
[*] Fixed bug where players would not have any items after a map change
[*] Fixed bug where the mask and hat wouldn't load on players
[/list]

notes.title: 16th November Patch.
notes.content:
We are testing new patch with following updates:
[list]
[*] Fixed up the main menu screens.
[*] Added a separate browser for lobbies vs servers.
[*] Fixed bug that was preventing sights from showing up in the main menu.
[*] Fixed bug that was preventing the suppressor from being equippable in the main menu.
[*] Fixed bug with the stat material not showing red lines for worse stats.
[*] Added weapon loading back into the main menu.
[*] Finished updating the main menu files.
[*] Added proper weapon loading to the character renderer.
[*] Finished updating the loadout plugin files.
[*] Finished updating the main menu files.
[*] New loading for weapons and attachments that will allow for easier replication.
[*] All meshes, textures, animations, sounds and particles for weapons are now loaded in the background as they are needed.
[/list]
